subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should Control UI add a persistent topbar display for active model plus token or provider usage status, or should existing Chat, Usage, /status, /usage, TUI, and CLI surfaces remain the supported placements?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but status meaning, freshness, density, and narrow-viewport behavior are product/UX choices rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Define a compact topbar contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical model, context, session-usage, and provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

options.title: Decline topbar placement
options.body: Close after a maintainer decision and document that Chat, Usage, /status, /usage, TUI, and CLI are the supported usage-awareness surfaces.

options.title: Route token-widget scope to chat
options.body: Keep this issue limited to active-model topbar placement and track richer chat quota/cost/widget work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167.

recommendation.title: Define a compact topbar contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify which canonical model, context, session-usage, and provider-usage fields may appear in the topbar, including stale and unavailable states.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the freshest adjacent Control UI, provider billing, and issue-review context for deciding topbar placement versus existing Usage/chat surfaces.
